title: Feasibility and Acceptance of Interprofessional Balint Groups in Oncology
summary:
Healthcare professionals are often exposed to significant stress and pressure in their daily work. In oncology settings in particular, professionals face not only medical challenges but also considerable emotional strain.
In addition, working in oncology departments requires close interprofessional collaboration, which is often accompanied by communication challenges. 
Balint groups offer participants a safe space to reflect together on particularly challenging encounters and events. 
This study aims to investigate whether it is possible to integrate regular meetings of interprofessional Balint groups into the daily clinical routine and to implement them in practice within oncology care.  
The findings regarding the feasibility and acceptance of interprofessional Balint groups are intended to serve as a basis for an effectiveness study.
